say:23:1611133015:0.source_cn: 没有选择……作为梅林，哪怕您不情愿，也必须面对这些事情...
say:23:1611133015:0.male: So even if you didn't want to, as Merlin, you had to face these things?
say:23:1611133015:0.female: So even if you didn't want to, as Merlin, you had to face these things?

say:24:1611133010:0.text: I knew you'd say that, but it still makes me sad thinking about what you gave up...
say:24:1611133010:0.source_cn: 我知道您会这么说，但我还是会为您的付出感到难过……
say:24:1611133010:0.male: I knew you'd say that, but it still makes me sad thinking about what you gave up...
say:24:1611133010:0.female: I knew you'd say that, but it still makes me sad thinking about what you gave up...

say:25:1611133011:0.text: You're right. Dwelling on what's done won't change anything.
say:25:1611133011:0.source_cn: 您说得对，为了发生过的事情而后悔是没有意义的。
say:25:1611133011:0.male: You're right. Dwelling on what's done won't change anything.
say:25:1611133011:0.female: You're right. Dwelling on what's done won't change anything.

say:2:1611134001:0.text: This memory is so hard to understand! What's the Sea of Stars?
say:2:1611134001:0.source_cn: 这段记忆好难理解啊！星海是什么？
say:2:1611134001:0.male: This memory is so hard to understand! What's the Sea of Stars?
say:2:1611134001:0.female: This memory is so hard to understand! What's the Sea of Stars?

say:4:1611134002:0.text: Were you researching the origins of life? The Sea of Stars... the Primordial Dragon... Magister, why were you studying these things? Do they have something to do with magic?
say:4:1611134002:0.source_cn: 您过去在研究生命的起源？星海……初始之龙……梅林大人，...
say:4:1611134002:0.male: Were you researching the origins of life? The Sea of Stars... the Primordial Dragon... Magister, why were you studying these things? Do they have something to do with magic?
say:4:1611134002:0.female: Were you researching the origins of life? The Sea of Stars... the Primordial Dragon... Magister, why were you studying these things? Do they have something to do with magic?

say:5:1611134003:0.text: Wait, you were even researching the goddess Dura and her divine authority?!
say:5:1611134003:0.source_cn: 等等，您、您居然还在研究艾雅女神和祂的权柄？！
say:5:1611134003:0.male: Wait, you were even researching the goddess Dura and her divine authority?!
say:5:1611134003:0.female: Wait, you were even researching the goddess Dura and her divine authority?!

say:6:1611134004:0.text: Dura above! Most believers and the Temple of Light would consider this blasphemy!
say:6:1611134004:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，在大多数信徒和圣堂的眼中，这样的研究是一种渎神！
say:6:1611134004:0.male: Dura above! Most believers and the Temple of Light would consider this blasphemy!
say:6:1611134004:0.female: Dura above! Most believers and the Temple of Light would consider this blasphemy!

say:8:1611134005:0.text: No wonder you kept these memories locked away. They're secrets that must never be revealed!
say:8:1611134005:0.source_cn: 怪不得梅林大人把这些记忆之星放在密室里，它们绝对是不能...
say:8:1611134005:0.male: No wonder you kept these memories locked away. They're secrets that must never be revealed!
say:8:1611134005:0.female: No wonder you kept these memories locked away. They're secrets that must never be revealed!

say:10:1611134006:0.text: Sea of Stars... Life... Dura... A voice echoes in your mind, familiar yet distant.
say:10:1611134006:0.source_cn: 星海……生命……艾雅……有什么声音在你脑海中跃动着，熟...
say:10:1611134006:0.male: Sea of Stars... Life... Dura... A voice echoes in your mind, familiar yet distant.
say:10:1611134006:0.female: Sea of Stars... Life... Dura... A voice echoes in your mind, familiar yet distant.

say:11:1611134007:0.text: You try to grasp it, but the voice vanishes as quickly as it came, taking that sense of familiarity with it.
say:11:1611134007:0.source_cn: 你试图回想起来，但脑海中的声音一瞬即逝，连带着刚才的熟...
say:11:1611134007:0.male: You try to grasp it, but the voice vanishes as quickly as it came, taking that sense of familiarity with it.
say:11:1611134007:0.female: You try to grasp it, but the voice vanishes as quickly as it came, taking that sense of familiarity with it.

choice_prompt:12:1611134007.male: You try to grasp it, but the voice vanishes as quickly as it came, taking that sense of familiarity with it.
choice_prompt:12:1611134007.female: You try to grasp it, but the voice vanishes as quickly as it came, taking that sense of familiarity with it.

say:14:1611134008:0.text: Don't worry. We won't tell a soul.
say:14:1611134008:0.source_cn: 放心，梅林大人，我们绝不会说出去的。
say:14:1611134008:0.male: Don't worry. We won't tell a soul.
say:14:1611134008:0.female: Don't worry. We won't tell a soul.

say:15:1611134010:0.text: The rest of the Memory Stars are floating up high. I can't reach any of them...
say:15:1611134010:0.source_cn: 剩下的记忆之星都浮在空中，上面那些一个都够不着……
say:15:1611134010:0.male: The rest of the Memory Stars are floating up high. I can't reach any of them...
say:15:1611134010:0.female: The rest of the Memory Stars are floating up high. I can't reach any of them...

choice:12:0:1.text: These records must not leave this room!
choice:12:0:1.male: These records must not leave this room!
choice:12:0:1.female: These records must not leave this room!

say:19:1611134009:0.text: Don't worry. We'll keep what we saw a secret.
say:19:1611134009:0.source_cn: 放心，梅林大人，刚才看到的信息我们绝不会说出去的。
say:19:1611134009:0.male: Don't worry. We'll keep what we saw a secret.
say:19:1611134009:0.female: Don't worry. We'll keep what we saw a secret.

choice:12:1:2.text: Let's focus on finding the key Memory Star.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 还是先找关键的记忆之星吧
choice:12:1:2.male: Let's focus on finding the key Memory Star.
choice:12:1:2.female: Let's focus on finding the key Memory Star.

say:0:1611134101:0.text: Who are the current Morgan and Gala? I can't remember...
say:0:1611134101:0.source_cn: 现任的摩根和加拉会是谁呢？我想不起来了……
say:0:1611134101:0.male: Who are the current Morgan and Gala? I can't remember...
say:0:1611134101:0.female: Who are the current Morgan and Gala? I can't remember...

say:3:1611135001:0.text: The Memory Star I wanted... You really did find it.
say:3:1611135001:0.source_cn: 我想要的记忆之星——你们果然找到它了。
say:3:1611135001:0.male: The Memory Star I wanted... You really did find it.
say:3:1611135001:0.female: The Memory Star I wanted... You really did find it.

say:4:1611135002:0.text: Hand it over, or I'll take it by force. Need a moment to decide?
say:4:1611135002:0.source_cn: 交给我，或者我抢走它。你们要商量一下再给我个答案吗？
say:4:1611135002:0.male: Hand it over, or I'll take it by force. Need a moment to decide?
say:4:1611135002:0.female: Hand it over, or I'll take it by force. Need a moment to decide?

say:5:1611135003:0.text: Gervan? Your legs... they really are healed.
say:5:1611135003:0.source_cn: 格墨文？你的腿……果然已经痊愈了。

say:6:1611135004:0.text: You've suspected me for some time, haven't you? All those tests, those probing questions... Well, here's your answer, clear as day. Aren't you satisfied now?
say:6:1611135004:0.source_cn: 你不是早就怀疑我、试探我了吗？我现在给了你一个明确的回...

say:7:1611135005:0.text: ... Why would you sink so low? Don't you care about yourself—or your family's honor?
say:7:1611135005:0.source_cn: ……你为何要自甘堕落！你不在乎自己，也不在意家族的声望吗？

say:8:1611135006:0.text: Oh, I care plenty about myself. That's why, when the Adamant Syndicate offered me a way to heal my legs, I agreed without a second thought.
say:8:1611135006:0.source_cn: 我很在乎自己啊，所以当我得知有机会治好腿伤时，立刻答应...

say:9:1611135007:0.text: As for my family... what have they ever given me?
say:9:1611135007:0.source_cn: 至于家族……家族给了我什么？！

say:10:1611135008:0.text: A Marquis, heir to the Hastings line, a man of rank and power in the court—how could he be someone who can't even walk without a wheelchair?
say:10:1611135008:0.source_cn: 堂堂的世袭侯爵、黑斯廷斯家族的继承人、宫廷里的实权者，...

say:11:1611135009:0.text: "Doesn't Marquis Gervais have any other heirs? How disgraceful!" If I had been whole, those whispers would never have reached my ears.
say:11:1611135009:0.source_cn: “嘉德侯爵难道没有其他继承人了吗？这也太不体面了”！如...

say:12:1611135010:0.text: My family was watching me, testing me. They wanted to see if I could live up to the Hastings name. They weighed my worth, judged me, and looked for a place to set me down—like a cracked piece of porcelain.
say:12:1611135010:0.source_cn: 家族在观察我的反应。看我能否担得起黑斯廷斯之名，他们权...

say:13:1611135011:0.text: But I'm not porcelain. I healed myself!
say:13:1611135011:0.source_cn: 但我不是瓷器，我治愈了自己！

say:14:1611135012:0.text: If you had just talked to someone, your friends—
say:14:1611135012:0.source_cn: 如果你能找其他人商量商量，找你的朋友——

say:15:1611135013:0.text: Friends? What good would that do? Could they make me the next Marquis?
say:15:1611135013:0.source_cn: 朋友？商量又能怎么样，能让我成为下一任侯爵吗？

say:16:1611135014:0.text: But the Adamant Syndicate was different. They promised to restore my legs, to give me everything a Marquis should possess—
say:16:1611135014:0.source_cn: 但黑金商会不一样，他们承诺让我的双腿恢复如初，得到嘉德...

say:17:1611135015:0.text: —all I have to do is take the Memory Star from your hands.
say:17:1611135015:0.source_cn: ——只要我拿到你们手中的这颗记忆之星！
say:17:1611135015:0.male: —all I have to do is take the Memory Star from your hands.
say:17:1611135015:0.female: —all I have to do is take the Memory Star from your hands.

say:20:1611135016:0.text: D-don't even think about it! Gervan, this is the real Magister Merlin. You can't possibly win!
say:20:1611135016:0.source_cn: 你、你别想！格墨文，你面前这位是真正的梅林大人！你绝对...
say:20:1611135016:0.male: D-don't even think about it! Gervan, this is the real Magister Merlin. You can't possibly win!
say:20:1611135016:0.female: D-don't even think about it! Gervan, this is the real Magister Merlin. You can't possibly win!

say:21:1611135017:0.text: The Adamant Syndicate is just using you as a pawn! Once they get what they want, they'll throw you away!
say:21:1611135017:0.source_cn: 黑金商会只是在利用你，将你当做破局的棋子。只要达成目的...

say:22:1611135018:0.text: ... It's too late for that, Silven. You know me. Once I choose a path, I don't turn back. And I can't now.
say:22:1611135018:0.source_cn: ……已经走到这一步，休，你知道的，我不会回头，也无法回头。

say:23:1611135019:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know you're Merlin. The one I once looked up to, the one I could never catch up to. My greatest rival.
say:23:1611135019:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know you're Merlin. The one I once looked up to, the one I could never catch up to. My greatest rival.
say:23:1611135019:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I know you're Merlin. The one I once looked up to, the one I could never catch up to. My greatest rival.

say:1:1611139001:0.text: Gervan, stop! You set all of this in motion, and now you don't have the stomach to see it through?
say:1:1611139001:0.source_cn: 格墨文，住手！你做出了这一切，却没有胆量面对最后的结果？！

say:4:1611139002:0.text: See it through... to my failure, again.
say:4:1611139002:0.source_cn: 结果……就是我再次失败了。

say:5:1611139003:0.text: Why? Why can't I ever win?
say:5:1611139003:0.source_cn: 为什么？为什么我永远赢不了？

say:6:1611139004:0.text: I've given everything I had, but someone always stands in my way. First Cassadee, and now you!
say:6:1611139004:0.source_cn: 我已经付出了所有努力，但始终有人挡在面前，先是科丝蒂，...
say:6:1611139004:0.male: I've given everything I had, but someone always stands in my way. First Cassadee, and now you!
say:6:1611139004:0.female: I've given everything I had, but someone always stands in my way. First Cassadee, and now you!

say:7:1611139005:0.text: Why should one accident make me lose everything? I've fought so hard to prove myself, yet I can never surpass the natural prodigy!
say:7:1611139005:0.source_cn: 为什么仅是一次意外，我就要失去一切？我拼命想证明自己，...

say:8:1611139006:0.text: Merlin, you're a living legend. People sing of your deeds, honor surrounds you... and you've never even had to pay a price.
say:8:1611139006:0.source_cn: 梅林，你是传奇的人物，你活在荣誉和赞颂下，你的故事被人...
say:8:1611139006:0.male: Merlin, you're a living legend. People sing of your deeds, honor surrounds you... and you've never even had to pay a price.
say:8:1611139006:0.female: Merlin, you're a living legend. People sing of your deeds, honor surrounds you... and you've never even had to pay a price.

say:9:1611139007:0.text: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!
say:9:1611139007:0.source_cn: 为什么是你，为什么是你们，不是我？！
say:9:1611139007:0.male: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!
say:9:1611139007:0.female: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!

choice_prompt:11:1611139007.text: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!
choice_prompt:11:1611139007.source_cn: 为什么是你，为什么是你们，不是我？！
choice_prompt:11:1611139007.male: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!
choice_prompt:11:1611139007.female: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!

say:16:1611139010:0.text: But you'll also have to sacrifice yourself for Esperia, just like Merlin did.
say:16:1611139010:0.source_cn: 但你要像梅林大人那样，为拯救伊索米亚而自我牺牲！
say:16:1611139010:0.male: But you'll also have to sacrifice yourself for Esperia, just like Merlin did.
say:16:1611139010:0.female: But you'll also have to sacrifice yourself for Esperia, just like Merlin did.

say:19:1611139012:0.text: We saw his memories... his doubts... and yet, even so, he made the right choice. Could you do the same?
say:19:1611139012:0.male: We saw his memories... his doubts... and yet, even so, he made the right choice. Could you do the same?
say:19:1611139012:0.female: We saw her memories... her doubts... and yet, even so, she made the right choice. Could you do the same?

say:22:1611139014:0.text: Magister Merlin is right, Gervan. You were born with every advantage, a name that opens doors. Even without a title, you had more resources than any of us could dream of.
say:22:1611139014:0.source_cn: 梅林大人说得没错，格墨文，你拥有我们都无法企及的家世，...
say:22:1611139014:0.male: Magister Merlin is right, Gervan. You were born with every advantage, a name that opens doors. Even without a title, you had more resources than any of us could dream of.
say:22:1611139014:0.female: Magister Merlin is right, Gervan. You were born with every advantage, a name that opens doors. Even without a title, you had more resources than any of us could dream of.

say:23:1611139015:0.text: Look at me. I'm just ordinary. Born into a fallen noble family. I scraped my way into the Serene Lyceum, but I'm nothing special. My luck isn't good or bad, it's just... average.
say:23:1611139015:0.source_cn: 你看，我才是那个什么都不出色的人。出身算是贵族，但早已...

say:24:1611139016:0.text: But I have my own goal. You all know that. I swore I would restore my family's honor.
say:24:1611139016:0.source_cn: 但我也有我自己的目标，你们都知道的，我发誓要恢复家族的荣光。

say:25:1611139017:0.text: Gervan, whether it's walking the path of magic or being your friend, everything I did was for that goal.
say:25:1611139017:0.source_cn: 格墨文，走魔法道路也好、和你成为朋友也好，的确都是我为...

say:26:1611139018:0.text: And even if I lost everything, I wouldn't give up. I'd find another way, keep moving forward. That's my path.
say:26:1611139018:0.source_cn: 可哪怕失去了这一切，我也不会放弃，我会找到其他的路，继...

say:28:1611139020:0.text: So, what now? You're going to interrogate me here, or throw me in a cell?
say:28:1611139020:0.source_cn: 你们打算就地审问我，或者是送我去监狱？

say:29:1611139021:0.text: No. That's not our call. We're turning you over to Envoy Evie; she'll handle it from there.
say:29:1611139021:0.source_cn: 不，我们无权做这些事，我们会将你交给伊芙特使，剩下的事...

say:31:1611139023:0.text: I'll be waiting in my cell. Let's see which one of you ends up the true winner...
say:31:1611139023:0.source_cn: 我会在监狱里等着，看看你们谁才是最后的胜利者……

narration:32:1611139024:0.text: You use a binding spell to restrain Gervan, ensuring he can't escape.
narration:32:1611139024:0.source_cn: 你用法术禁锢了格墨文，保证他无法从魔法塔中逃脱
narration:32:1611139024:0.male: You use a binding spell to restrain Gervan, ensuring he can't escape.
narration:32:1611139024:0.female: You use a binding spell to restrain Gervan, ensuring he can't escape.

narration:33:1611139025:0.text: He'll be handed over to Evie once the selection exam officially concludes.
narration:33:1611139025:0.source_cn: 他将被移交给伊芙——在选拔赛彻底结束之后

choice:13:0:1.text: You become Merlin. Take all the glory, but—
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 你成为梅林，享受所有荣耀，但……
choice:13:0:1.male: You become Merlin. Take all the glory, but—
choice:13:0:1.female: You become Merlin. Take all the glory, but—

choice:11:0:1.text: Then how about we trade places?
choice:11:0:1.male: Then how about we trade places?
choice:11:0:1.female: Then how about we trade places?

say:1:1611140001:0.text: Merlin, at this point... with Cyran as the mastermind, will the royal court even recognize the new court mage?
say:1:1611140001:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，事情到了这个地步，作为这一切的幕后主使，迪尔...
say:1:1611140001:0.male: Merlin, at this point... with Cyran as the mastermind, will the royal court even recognize the new court mage?
say:1:1611140001:0.female: Merlin, at this point... with Cyran as the mastermind, will the royal court even recognize the new court mage?

say:2:1611140002:0.text: It's hard to believe, but I doubt this will even leave a scratch on Cyran's reputation.
say:2:1611140002:0.source_cn: 虽然听起来很难以置信，但我认为这件事对迪尔格雷影响并不大。

say:3:1611140003:0.text: What?! How? We have Gervan! Envoy Evie will surely get him to confess everything!
say:3:1611140003:0.source_cn: 欸？！怎么可能！我们抓到了格墨文，伊芙特使肯定有办法让...

say:4:1611140004:0.text: You're thinking of court politics like it's a straightforward game. Cyran only served as a judge for the exam. He never got directly involved in anything else.
say:4:1611140004:0.source_cn: 你们把宫廷政治想得太简单了。你看，除了担任选拔赛评审，...

say:5:1611140005:0.text: He knows the court inside out—the balance between the royal family, the nobles, and the Temple of Light. And he's used it to his advantage.
say:5:1611140005:0.source_cn: 迪尔格雷对宫廷政治熟稔于心，王室、贵族与圣堂几方之间的...

say:6:1611140006:0.text: He's kept his hands clean, stirring the pot, letting others do the work. The headmaster's death, the corruption in the exam... none of it can be tied to him.
say:6:1611140006:0.source_cn: 他让自己置身事外，挑拨、教唆、顺水推舟地达成现在的局面...

say:7:1611140007:0.text: And did you notice? Even when he was cornered, Gervan never mentioned his name.
say:7:1611140007:0.source_cn: 就连刚才面对格墨文，他也没有提到迪尔格雷的名字……一个...

say:9:1611140009:0.text: A man as sharp as Cyran has surely already destroyed every shred of evidence linking him to Gervan. And as for him knowing dark magic? If that gets out, it'll be a minor scandal, nothing more.
say:9:1611140009:0.source_cn: 以迪尔格雷的敏锐，恐怕早就处理掉了所有和格墨文来往的证...

say:10:1611140010:0.text: So... we're still going through the process of choosing a new court mage today?
say:10:1611140010:0.source_cn: 也就是说，今天还是要按照流程选出一位新的宫廷魔法师？

say:12:1611140012:0.text: Then who will it be? Gervan's out. That leaves Cassadee, and... Wait. Magister Merlin, you?!
